featurePolicy.unlistedDefault: Shelved art and collision together; parent aligns earned/owned reveal before integration.
featurePolicy.oldIsle: Replace legacy grass/stepping override with a deliberate compatible coastal location; preserve discoveries.
featurePolicy.optionalActivities: Packed by default, one deliberately selected at a time; existing unlocks and progress retained.
featurePolicy.frontierStaging: Existing secret/room identities and earned discoveries are retained; optional places remain shelved until deliberate placement in an unlocked region. No new default side activity or arrival overlay.

physicalContract.outline: Closed simple polygon; final edge implicitly closes. Same continuous land boundary drives ocean paint/foot/fish/rod/reflection/ripple/visitor geometry.
physicalContract.ocean: Logical ocean rectangle minus mainland polygon; separate freshwater pond remains inland. Render-only sea extends beyond logical bounds.
physicalContract.beach: Inland distance to the canonical coast in48x30world-pixel metric; no independent collision shoreline.
physicalContract.walkCover: Existing pier/bridge/work/ice walk-cover remains separate from underlying ocean. Do not erase water to draw deck.
physicalContract.cellRaster: Cell-centre kind is a lookup aid only; continuous geometry is authoritative at coasts.
physicalContract.reservation: Static footprint, doorway apron, rear art envelope and path are separately classified; rear art is not a new physical collider.
physicalContract.regions: Coast-clipped regions.polygons partition the entire physical mainland, including beaches, static aprons and public-looking routes. A closed region cannot be bypassed around a gate.
physicalContract.freshwater: freshwater.boundary is the shared continuous basin geometry. wet is a conservative placement/raster envelope, not the final collision outline.
physicalContract.landforms: Authored landforms polygon full colliders reserve actual mountain/ruin footprints; scenery must fit the same footprint.
physicalContract.gateCrossings: Each gate stands on its path at a natural crossing (arch, bridge, stair, pass). A closed region is locked whole; walls and the scarp keep open regions to their paths and shortcuts.
physicalContract.fresh: Gardens from earlier layouts start fresh here; nothing is carried over.

allotmentPolicy.treePriority: Every section has a coherent 2x2 or larger footprint, packed by kind near its paths. Starter beds stay 7x2 each.
allotmentPolicy.sharedFootprints: Larger plants may span adjoining open sections only when every section independently accepts the plant category and explicit family/area restriction. No overlap or ownership alias.

placementAnchors.policy: Only prior-set-out explicit feature.place/sight.place rows may use these hints after ordinary legality checks. No hint is a default reveal or ownership grant; packed:true retains complete progress without placing art.
